# Worker Completion Report Template

```text
Task:
Milestone:
Status: completed | blocked | needs-review

Repository:
Base commit:
Final commit:
Push status:
Final worktree status:

Why this work mattered:

Changed files:

Summary:

Prior-art updates:

Build / borrow / integrate decisions:

Benchmark updates:

Milestone gate result:
  declared quality target:
  achieved quality level:
  decision: continue | improve | reduce scope | pivot | discard

Validation performed:

Safety / non-goals preserved:

Known gaps:

Recommended next action:
```

## Requirements

A completion report is not enough if it only lists files changed.

It must explain:

- whether the milestone is actually done
- what evidence supports that claim
- what was learned from prior art
- whether any existing stronger system was found
- whether the roadmap should change
